perks.name: Subsistence

perks.name: Attrition Orbs

perks.name: Zen Moment

perks.name: Discord
perks.desc: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Rewind Rounds

perks.name: Rolling Storm
perks.desc:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.

perks.name: Onslaught
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon increase its rate of fire.

perks.name: Paracausal Affinity
perks.desc: Final blows of energy types matching this weapon's alignment grant increased damage for a short period of time. Light final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Darkness final blows boost Stasis and Strand weapons.

perks.name: Tap the Trigger
perks.desc: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.desc: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

perks.name: Voltshot
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

perks.name: Gear Shift
perks.desc: Reloading after a final blow or becoming amplified grants a period of increased damage. Stacks 5x.

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

perks.name: Cascade Point
perks.desc: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for a short duration.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Crossing Over
perks.desc: This weapon has increased range and handling for the top half of the magazine, while rounds from the bottom half of the magazine deal increased damage.

perks.name: Gravity Well
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon automatically gathers nearby ammo.

notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-God Arc-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal difficulty, particularly with Arc builds. Prosecutor is a precision auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "worse damage profile than balanced, but has barrier intrinsic". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, and a ×0.9 reduction in horizontal recoil, as per the Destiny Data Compendium. With the frame intrinsic, you don't really have to worry about Recoil Direction, so you can take your pick with the barrel perk to boost Handling, Stability or Range. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. There are double damage perk combinations available with Dragonfly in the first trait perk column, which procs a 4.5m Arc explosion on a crit kill - this is treated as weapon damage so can inherit damage boosts, and also proc subclass fragments. For Arc builds, in the second column Gear Shift stacks up to ×5 on reloads after kills or becoming Amplified for a refreshable 15s, granting up to a max ×1.35 damage boost, or for Arc target and AoE damage there's Rolling Storm to generate ×1 stack of Arc Bolt Charge (×2 when Amplified) on a kill, to trigger a lightning bolt at ×10 stacks, or Voltshot applies Arc Jolt to the next target you hit within 8s, after a reload within 5.3s of a kill, for additional damage on further hits plus chain lightning damage on nearby enemies. Aegis ranks the Crossing Over origin trait as F-Tier for PvE - it provides a little extra range and handling in the top half of the mag, and a small damage boost in the bottom starting at ×1.015 at 50% and ×1.03 with your penultimate and last shot. If you're interested, Prosecutor operates alongside other Prophecy Dungeon weapons like Adjudicator, Judgement, and Relentless to evoke a clinical, cosmic courtroom where The Nine evaluate humanity's worthiness. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.

warlockmaggie (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Prosecutor is an Arc Precision auto rifle with a number of solid options for PvE, especially the tried and true combos of Eddy Current with Rolling Storm or Dragonfly with Voltshot (that second one is limited to Raid/Dungeon/Trials weapons). For more generic options, Subsistence and Onslaught very good pairing (though Paracausal Affinity works here too). Well-rounded stats means you can safely pick whatever Barrels and Magazines, but I'll be leaning towards Reload and Stability." Recommended MW: Reload Speed or Stability.

warlockmaggie (PvP / Controller): "I've always been a fan of the 450 Autos in PvP; and the Prosecutor doesn't disappoint here. Crossing Over as the origin trait, paired with 4 different non-kill-requiring perks (Keep Away or Zen Moment + Tap the Trigger or Target Lock) means this brings a lot of potency without any real requirements. I'll be looking for Keep Away and TtT but any combination will be powerful (even Eddy Current and Onslaught get honorable mentions here)! Definitely try to farm one where possible!" Recommended MW: Range or Handling.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 141 from 27 May 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/51wAzrVIRJRsBHGTMCLZ0n?si=fade7bb615184d3e) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for clearing Minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. Prosecutor is a precision AR, with the frame intrinsic offering a more vertical recoil. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are pretty good - d2foundry.gg calculates that 60 Range equates to 29.20m ADS and 18.25m hipfire before damage falloff, 42 Stability is ×1.1619 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 46 Handling is 0.39s ready, 0.30s ADS and 0.36s stow speed, and 45 Reload Speed is a 1.89s reload. Recoil Direction is 69 (but you can ignore that with the frame intrinsic), and Zoom is 16, and Magazine size is 32 (max 44). With it being relatively easy to control you can push out the Range, or improve Handling. In the magazine perk slot, any of the combat effect mags are great or choose something that helps Reload Speed. For an all-round general use roll, in the first trait perk column Attrition Orbs will generate a power orb to proc armor mods after hitting enemies with roughly 2/3 of your magazine, Dragonfly generates a 4.5m Arc AoE explosion on crit kills, or Eddy Current boosts Reload Speed by +20 after sprinting for 1.5s (or +60 instantly when amplified) with a ×0.95 reload and handling animation. In the second column, for damage, Paracausal Affinity provides a ×1.2 boost for 6s following a light energy kill. The Crossing Over origin trait is a little strange, providing extra range and handling in the top half of the mag, and a damage boost in the bottom starting at ×1.015 at 50% and ×1.03 with your penultimate and last shot, while Gravity Well can be very useful to pick up ammo bricks within 5m on a manual reload. Recommended MW: Range or Handling, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Ionic Traces or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 97 from 13 March 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/4Uy7pfo5Thjtt2MF4vZitv?si=8e3adcb68d234006) with @ImpetusAlways, @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects. First-choice PvE pick for add clearing Minor Spec enemies in general content. Prosecutor has decent stats by comparison to its peers and as it's a precision frame, you should find it fairly easy to control despite the 69 recoil direction. With that being the case, you can push out the range with the barrel perk, and any of the combat effect rounds as a mag perk will add a little more - High-Cal rounds in particular will help stun your minor adds. If you're looking at Voltshot in the second trait column. you're going to need s snappy reload, so Flared Magwell can work well too. Keep Away is the only perk in the first trait column to add to reload, although to benefit, you'll need to keep your engagement solidly in the mid-range. Voltshot is fun, but remember that the perk inherits the weapon's combatant damage scaling, so it won't be as effective at clearing add crowds as a Voltshot hand cannon. The Crossing Over origin trait is useful all around for PvE, with bumps to range and handling in the top half of a magazine, and a small 3% damage boost at the bottom. Recommended MW: Reload Speed, with a damage boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.

The Crossing Over origin trait is useful all around for PvE, with bumps to range and handling in the top half of a magazine, and a small 3% damage boost at the bottom. Prosecutor has decent stats by comparison to its peers and as it's a precision frame, you should find it fairly easy to control despite the 69 recoil direction. With that being the case, you can push out the range with the barrel perk, and any of the combat effect rounds as a mag perk will add a little more - High-Cal rounds in particular will help stun your minor adds. Rewind Rounds is a cunning plan to take advantage of the origin trait's bottom of the mag damage boost by continually refreshing the bottom half of the mag, while Golden Tricorn's second damage stack is easy to proc with the Arc 3.0 toolkit, for a very hefty 50% damage boost. Recommended MW: Range, with a damage boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.
